description: This PHP source file defines a class ADODB_ldap for managing LDAP connections and operations, including connecting, binding, setting options, and retrieving server info. It also includes a recordset class ADORecordSet_ldap for handling LDAP query results. The file is part of the ADODB database abstraction layer tailored for LDAP.

classes.name: ADODB_ldap
classes.description: Handles LDAP connection, configuration, and server info retrieval.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ldap
classes.description: Manages LDAP query result sets and data fetching.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes an LDAP connection and binds with provided credentials.

methods.name: _inject_bind_options
methods.description: Sets LDAP connection options dynamically from an array.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Performs an LDAP search with specified filter.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Sets the LDAP base DN for subsequent operations.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP server configuration and version info.
